title: France Doubles Aster Missile Capacity on FDI Frigates From 16 to 32
excerpt: France's defence procurement agency DGA finalised an order with Naval Group and MBDA at Euronaval 2026 to raise the Aster capacity of FDI frigates from 16 to 32 missiles.
rank_math_title: France raises FDI frigate Aster capacity from 16 to 32 | Envanter Medya
rank_math_description: At Euronaval 2026 the DGA finalised an order with Naval Group and MBDA to double the Aster air-defence missile capacity of FDI frigates from 16 to 32.
